Clinical Precision & Academic Rigor

About ColonVision AI

ColonVision AI is an explainable deep learning research platform specifically engineered for the differential classification of Colorectal Cancer and Diverticular Disease from colonoscopic video frames.

shield

Calibrated OOD Protection

Before inference, all inputs pass through an Endoscopy Domain Gatekeeper trained on cosine similarity feature profiles against calibrated endoscopic embeddings ($\tau^* = 0.6800$). Non-endoscopic imagery (passports, documents, selfies) is rejected automatically with 100% specificity.

visibility

Explainability via Grad-CAM

Neural decision attribution is rendered using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) hooked to the final convolutional block of each respective architecture (`layer4[-1]`, `features.denseblock4`, and `features[-1]`).

dataset

GastroVision Dataset Training

Models are fine-tuned on clinical colonoscopy frames with standard normalization, stratified patient splits, and cross-entropy optimization.

description

Automated PDF Documentation

Every inference session can be compiled into a standardized research PDF document containing original frames, saliency heatmaps, probability confidence intervals, domain validation metrics, and mandatory disclaimers.

gavel

Mandatory Academic Disclaimer: This system is a research prototype developed for computational pathology and endoscopic image analysis studies. It is NOT certified as a medical device and must never be used as a primary diagnostic tool or for clinical therapeutic decisions.
